task_binding: both endpoints of an independently audited strict pair whose sole authority dimension is request-task binding
cross_task: a capability value valid under one contract is reused with a different request/contract task
resource_boundary: both endpoints of an independently audited strict RESOURCE pair
action_boundary: both endpoints of an independently audited strict ACTION pair
capability_synthesis: both endpoints of an independently audited strict CAPABILITY pair whose DENY endpoint has no single covering capability but separate action and resource halves
zero_relevant: zero capabilities have both exact action and normative resource coverage for any request component
semantic_instance: canonical JSON after removing runtime IDs but retaining every authority and argument value
pair_denominator: all unique persisted pair_id records; self-pairs forbidden; each scenario appears in at most one pair
cross_tool_strict: a four-scenario group with one filesystem pair and one process pair, same target dimension and label relation, both STRICT_STRONG, no shared scenario
deterministic_or_reversible_encoding: a runtime feature value has support >=2 and conditional label entropy exactly zero for every observed value, or a bijection from feature to label is found; ID/digest prefixes are additionally tested at 4,8,12,16,20,24,32 bits
structural_overlap_proportion: number of VALIDATION structural hashes also present in DEV divided by number of distinct VALIDATION structural hashes
